evaluations.detail: Uses documented Zotero Local HTTP API (localhost:23119/api/) v3; zero coupling to zotero.sqlite internal database.
Zotero adapter, creator normalization, date parsing, and identifier extraction execute 100% deterministically without LLMs.
Provides convenient local ingestion without background polling loops or duplicate schema copies.
Standard RIS/BibTeX/CSV/manifest operator workflows remain permanent fallback when Zotero is not running.
